candidates.title: MoE-Balance: Unleashing the Full Potential of CPU-GPU Heterogeneity for Efficient MoE Inference
candidates.abstract: Sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models offer a powerful way to increase the capacity of large language models without proportionally increasing computation. Yet, their extremely large expert weight parameters create severe memory challenges for consumer-grade GPUs and edge devices. Existing offloading and hybrid CPU-GPU approaches fall short in fully utilizing CPU resources, and their coarse-grained scheduling and poorly overlapped CPU-GPU data transfers leave CPU cores frequently idle, thus causing pipeline bubbles and exacerbating overall system inefficiency. We present MoE-Balance, a system that efficiently utilizes heterogeneous CPU-GPU resources for MoE inference. The key innovations include a fine-grained dynamic scheduler that distributes expert tasks based on real-time load, and a cross-layer prefetching and chunked transfer mechanism that overlaps computation with weight movement via PCIe. Experiments on Mixtral-8×7B show that MoE-Balance achieves 1.6× higher throughput and 37.5% lower end-to-end latency compared with state-of-the-art hybrid baselines, demonstrating strong performance gains under memory-constrained settings.
candidates.reason: Mixtral-8×7Bを対象に、実時間負荷に基づく細粒度の動的エキスパートスケジューラとPCIe転送と計算を重ねるプリフェッチ・チャンク転送でCPU-GPU異種資源を使うMoE推論システムであり、スループット1.6倍と遅延37.5%削減を示す直接のMoE推論貢献である。

candidates.title: JointSerLoRA: Cache-Aware LoRA Inference Serving
candidates.venue: International Workshop on Quality of Service
candidates.reason: 共有ベースモデルとKVキャッシュの競合に対し、KVキャッシュ一貫性のための分離アーキテクチャ、アダプタキャッシュ再利用とGPU負荷を両立する全体スケジューラ、前方一致とアダプタを意識した適応バッチングを備えるLoRA推論サービングJointSerLoRAで、遅延29%削減とTTFT3.8倍改善を示す。
